title: Make a Noise in the East, Attack in the West
era: Early Eastern Han · about 1,900 years ago

source.chapter: Make a Noise in the East, Attack in the West
source.quote: When the enemy's will is in confusion and he takes no precautions … seize him while he cannot command himself.

moral: Put the bustle on one side, let the guard watch there, and slip past on the other.
transfer: If a friend won't share, offer another toy.
